description: RESOLVE is an electricity resource-planning model maintained by Energy and Environmental Economics. Its published code and documentation describe a long-term optimisation of electric generation and transmission investments under reliability, policy and technical requirements. Users supply an electricity-system representation, demand, candidate resources, costs and policy constraints. Outputs are generation and transmission build choices and operating results for the modelled planning horizon. Geographic coverage comes from the zones and grid entered for a case; the public README does not assign a fixed country. AGPL-3.0 source and an installation test case are available. A limitation is that long-range investments depend on the selected resource costs, reliability criteria and policy scenario, so the model should not be read as a forecast. RESOLVE supports utility capacity and grid-expansion studies. The catalogue's model-pypsa is a separate open modelling engine, not a RESOLVE component. No test case or optimisation was run.
inputs: Generation, transmission, demand and candidate-resource data
name: RESOLVE electricity resource-planning model
